title: applied-ml experiment scratchpad - quant + eval notes
content:
Daily scratchpad - Maya Chen (applied-ml)

Goal: quick running notes for quantization + eval runs on candidate model variants; capture prompt sets that break, immediate TODOs, and ideas for further tests. Not polished.

1) Context / objective
- Trying PTQ (LLM.int8 / 4-bit) profiles on open-weights candidate: llama2-13b-chat and mistral-7b-v0.
- Want to compare: latency / throughput (tokens/s), memory (GPU), and quality regressions on curated prompt suite (instruction-following + code + math).
- Quick decision criteria: <=2% instruction-following score drop OR explainable hallucination cases AND 30-45% reduction in GPU mem for 4-bit vs fp16.

2) Environment / commands used
- Baseline (fp16): python infra/serve_eval.py --model llama2-13b-chat --dtype fp16 --batch 4 --seq 1024 --out results/baseline_llama2_13b.json
- PTQ 8-bit trial: python infra/quant_eval.py --model llama2-13b-chat --quant ptq8 --calib 2000 --out results/ptq8_llama2_13b.json
- 4-bit (GPTQ-style): python infra/quant_eval.py --model llama2-13b-chat --quant 4bit --gptq --calib 500 --out results/4bit_llama2_13b.json
- Eval harness: python eval/harness.py --preds results/*.json --suite eval_suites/instruction-following.json --metrics instr_score,perplexity,avg_latency

3) Quick results (first pass, single GPU: A100-40GB)
- Baseline fp16 (llama2-13b-chat): avg latency (per request, seq 512) = 420ms; tokens/s (generation) = 210; GPU mem = 26GB; instr_score = 0.87; avg perplexity = 9.4
- PTQ8: latency = 380ms; tokens/s = 235; GPU mem = 20.5GB; instr_score = 0.85 (-2.3%); perplexity = 9.9 (small up)
- 4bit GPTQ: latency = 340ms; tokens/s = 265; GPU mem = 12.3GB; instr_score = 0.80 (-8%); perplexity = 12.6 (noticeable)

Notes: PTQ8 looks promising (small quality delta, ~20% mem savings). 4-bit gave big mem win but instruction-following dropped more than threshold. Need targeted per-prompt analysis to see failure modes for GPTQ 4-bit.

4) Per-prompt failure checklist (samples where 4-bit failed but ptq8 OK)
- Long multi-step instructions with stateful references ("remember earlier step X and modify Y"): 4-bit tends to drop context coherence.
- Code generation: 4-bit produces syntax errors / missing closing parens more often.
- Math reasoning: hallucination on intermediate steps, mis-summed numbers.

Example prompt where 4-bit broke (short):
"Write a Python function that computes the rolling average of a list of numbers and include a doctest example."
- fp16 / ptq8 output: clean function + doctest passes
- 4-bit output: missing edge-case handling and doctest example has typo in list literal

5) Prompt set updates (add these to eval suite)
- rolling-average-doctest (code)
- multi-step-edit-context (instruction-tracking)
- long-chain-arith (math chain-of-thought but compare final answer)

6) Quick experiments to run next (TODOs)
- [ ] Re-run GPTQ 4-bit calibration with larger calib set (increase from 500 -> 2000) and check if perf improves for code prompts (hypothesis: calibration sample diversity matters).
- [ ] Try hybrid strategy: keep attention kv in 8-bit, weights in 4-bit (if infra supports); measure mem and instr_score.
- [ ] Run evals on Mistral-7b-v0 (fp16 vs 4-bit) — smaller model may tolerate 4-bit better.
- [ ] Collect token-level divergence traces for 10 failing prompts (diff model outputs) and drop into PR#342 for triage.

7) Quick performance tuning notes
- Batching: for small interactive latency we want batch=1 for p99, but throughput runs set batch=8 to estimate tokens/s. Document these in results headers.
- KV cache warm-up: first request includes kv warm-up penalty; compute steady-state token/s over long generation (>=512 tokens) for throughput comparisons.

8) Hypotheses / open questions
- Is the instr_score drop for 4-bit concentrated in certain tokens (e.g., punctuation) or semantic content? Need token-level KL / cross-entropy diffs.
- Does PTQ8 introduce bias to stop early (shorter outputs)? Check average output length diff.

9) Notes for write-up / PR
- Include short table: model | dtype | gpu_mem | instr_score | latency. Add per-suite deltas. Put failing prompt examples inline.
- Action: open issue INF-5123 linking sample diffs + suggested mitigations (hybrid quant, more calib).

Misc: small TODOs
- Ping infra for spot on 80GB vram host to try 30b variant (probably next week).
- Save raw logits for 50 eval prompts to S3: s3://redwood-experiments/maya/2026-03-04/logits.tar.gz

End of scratchpad.

(rough, informal, notes to self)
